supportMessage: Use a direct wired USB connection. Do not unplug the keyboard until the installer reports completion. Complete corresponding firmware source is unavailable; bundled binaries are retained temporarily and are not represented as GPLv2-compliant. See firmware/GPL-COMPLIANCE.md.

firmware.name: Patched firmware
firmware.description: Latest patched release. Includes the vendor's wireless stability update and fixes VIA hue control.

firmware.name: Patched firmware
firmware.description: Legacy patched release for restoring the original 1.04 firmware while retaining the VIA hue fix.

firmware.name: Per-key RGB streaming firmware
firmware.description: Experimental wired frame streaming on the existing HID interface. Requires matching PKRG v2 host tools/plugins. Wired frame delivery/readback is verified; Windows measurements show no throughput gain. Physical appearance and sustained operation remain unverified. Back up VIA configuration before flashing.

plugins.name: Wobkey Crush 80 (Wired) V2
plugins.description: Recommended wired plugin. Dynamically updates canvas hue without overriding the keyboard's active effect mode.

plugins.name: Wobkey Crush 80 (Wireless) V2
plugins.description: Recommended wireless plugin for 2.4G dongle. Dynamically updates canvas hue without overriding the keyboard's active effect mode.

plugins.name: Wobkey Crush 80 (Wired) V1
plugins.description: Legacy wired plugin. Sets keyboard to solid-colour static effect mode and syncs averaged canvas color.

plugins.name: Wobkey Crush 80 (Wireless) V1
plugins.description: Legacy wireless plugin for 2.4G dongle. Sets keyboard to solid-colour static effect mode and syncs averaged canvas color.

plugins.name: Wobkey Crush 80 (Wired) V3 Per-Key
plugins.description: Frame-streaming per-key plugin with one acknowledgement per complete frame and optional timing diagnostics. Requires the PKRG v2 firmware upgrade; older per-key firmware is rejected before lighting writes.

plugins.name: Wobkey Crush 80 (Wireless) V3 Per-Key
plugins.description: Experimental per-key plugin for the 2.4G dongle using acknowledged configuration chunks, not the wired streaming commands. Requires PKRG v2 firmware on the keyboard; radio forwarding and sleep/wake are unverified. Never flash keyboard firmware onto the dongle.
